result.reason: The operative grant covers Company’s affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, is perpetual and irrevocable, and is transferable in the specified M&A circumstances, satisfying the fallback transfer position. Subscription termination is inapplicable. However, adding “worldwide” and reordering the provisions were not required by the playbook, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Contractor’s background-IP ownership is otherwise preserved. Drafting quality is reduced by the retained malformed phrase “create, derivative version” and awkward sentence structure.
